title: fynkel.Collider
description: A collision shape on the entity, in the entity's local frame scaled by the entity's world scale. Alone it is static geometry; with a `RigidBody` it is that body's shape.

size.description: Metres; what each component means depends on `shape`.

mesh.description: The mesh sub-asset for `shape: mesh` (`mesh/<n>` of an imported glTF), ignored otherwise.

offset.description: Local translation of the shape from the entity's origin, metres.

material.description: A `.physicsmaterial.json` (ADR-0025): its friction, bounciness and combine rules replace `friction` and `restitution`. None: those two apply, averaged with the other collider's.

friction.description: Coulomb friction coefficient, `>= 0` (0.5 is rubber on concrete); ignored when `material` names one.

is_sensor.description: A sensor reports trigger events and applies no forces.

mask.description: Which layers this collider collides with (bit `i` = the project's `layers[i]`; both sides must agree). Its own layer is its entity's `fynkel.Layer` (ADR-0020).
